content.hebrew: Yona, le’edech re’i / ḳolech betsevaḥ se’i
content.transliteration: יוֹנָה, לְאֵידֵךְ רְאִי / קוֹלֵךְ בְּצֶוַח שְׂאִי
content.english: O dove, see, and raise your voice in cry,

content.hebrew: Ki va ve’artsech she’i / yaḡon beḡilayich.
content.transliteration: כִּי בָא בְאַרְצֵךְ שְׁאִי / יָגוֹן בְּגִילָיִךְ:
content.english: For destruction has befallen your land; and anguish, your joy.

content.hebrew: Yona, le’edech re’i / ḳolech betsevaḥ se’i
content.transliteration: יוֹנָה, לְאֵידֵךְ רְאִי / קוֹלֵךְ בְּצֶוַח שְׂאִי
content.english: O dove, see, and raise your voice in cry,

content.hebrew: Ki va ve’artsech she’i / yaḡon beḡilayich.
content.transliteration: כִּי בָא בְאַרְצֵךְ שְׁאִי / יָגוֹן בְּגִילָיִךְ:
content.english: For destruction has befallen your land; and anguish, your joy.

content.hebrew: Yonat ahavim beni / ḳinnech bemidbar veni
content.transliteration: י֯וֹנַת אֲהָבִים, בְּנִי / קִנֵּךְ בְּמִדְבָּר, וְנִי
content.english: O beloved dove, build your nest in the wilderness, and moans

content.hebrew: Vahi keshirim ‘ani / mara beḳolayich.
content.transliteration: וָהִי כְּשִׁירִים עֲנִי / מָרָה בְּקוֹלָיִךְ:
content.english: And wails you should call out, like songs, bitterly, with your voice.

content.hebrew: Yona, le’edech re’i / ḳolech betsevaḥ se’i
content.transliteration: יוֹנָה, לְאֵידֵךְ רְאִי / קוֹלֵךְ בְּצֶוַח שְׂאִי
content.english: O dove, see, and raise your voice in cry,

content.hebrew: Ki va ve’artsech she’i / yaḡon beḡilayich.
content.transliteration: כִּי בָא בְאַרְצֵךְ שְׁאִי / יָגוֹן בְּגִילָיִךְ:
content.english: For destruction has befallen your land; and anguish, your joy.

content.hebrew: Uv-har ḥoravot ‘ali / tannim nehi sha’ali
content.transliteration: וּ֯בְהַר חֳרָבוֹת עֲלִי / תַּנִּים נְהִי שַׁאֲלִי
content.english: And ascend the mount of destruction, borrow the moan of jackals,

content.hebrew: ‘Immam sefodi beli / dumam leḥelayich.
content.transliteration: עִמָּם סְפֹדִי, בְּלִי / דוּמָם לְחֵלָיִךְ:
content.english: With them, mourn, giving no silence to your strength.

content.hebrew: Yona, le’edech re’i / ḳolech betsevaḥ se’i
content.transliteration: יוֹנָה, לְאֵידֵךְ רְאִי / קוֹלֵךְ בְּצֶוַח שְׂאִי
content.english: O dove, see, and raise your voice in cry,

content.hebrew: Ki va ve’artsech she’i / yaḡon beḡilayich.
content.transliteration: כִּי בָא בְאַרְצֵךְ שְׁאִי / יָגוֹן בְּגִילָיִךְ:
content.english: For destruction has befallen your land; and anguish, your joy.

content.hebrew: Sifḳi beyadech ve’i / ḳiri be‘etsev be’i
content.transliteration: סִ֯פְקִי בְּיָדֵךְ, וְאִי / קִרְאִי בְּעֶצֶב בְּאִי
content.english: Clap your hands [in anguish], and oh, alas, / call out with sadness, with “Oh, alas!”

content.hebrew: Merḥaḳ kenesher de’i / bimé shechulayich.
content.transliteration: מֶרְחָק כְּנֶשֶׁר דְּאִי / בִּימֵי שְׁכוּלָיִךְ:
content.english: Fly to a distance, like an eagle, in the days of your bereavement.

content.hebrew: Yona, le’edech re’i / ḳolech betsevaḥ se’i
content.transliteration: יוֹנָה, לְאֵידֵךְ רְאִי / קוֹלֵךְ בְּצֶוַח שְׂאִי
content.english: O dove, see, and raise your voice in cry,

content.hebrew: Ki va ve’artsech she’i / yaḡon beḡilayich.
content.transliteration: כִּי בָא בְאַרְצֵךְ שְׁאִי / יָגוֹן בְּגִילָיִךְ:
content.english: For destruction has befallen your land; and anguish, your joy.

content.hebrew: Pitḥi seḡoré leviv / mili yeḡoné sheviv
content.transliteration: פִּ֯תְחִי סְגוֹרֵי לְבִיב / מִלְאִי יְגוֹנֵי שְׁבִיב
content.english: Open your heart’s enclosure, fill up with anguish about the flame

content.hebrew: Bi‘er beḳodesh seviv / mizbaḥ kelilayich.
content.transliteration: בִּעֵר בְּקֹדֶשׁ, סְבִיב / מִזְבַּח כְּלִילָיִךְ:
content.english: That burned in the Temple, around your crowning altar.

content.hebrew: Yona, le’edech re’i / ḳolech betsevaḥ se’i
content.transliteration: יוֹנָה, לְאֵידֵךְ רְאִי / קוֹלֵךְ בְּצֶוַח שְׂאִי
content.english: O dove, see, and raise your voice in cry,

content.hebrew: Ki va ve’artsech she’i / yaḡon beḡilayich.
content.transliteration: כִּי בָא בְאַרְצֵךְ שְׁאִי / יָגוֹן בְּגִילָיִךְ:
content.english: For destruction has befallen your land; and anguish, your joy.

content.hebrew: Badad le’erets shevi / dim‘a le‘enech revi
content.transliteration: בָּ֯דָד לְאֶרֶץ שְׁבִי / דִּמְעָה לְעֵינֵךְ רְוִי
content.english: Sit alone on the ground, and overflow your eye with tears,

content.hebrew: Kiver lemé sha’avi / yaveshu neḥalayich.
content.transliteration: כִּבְאֵר לְמֵי שַׁאֲבִי / יָבְשׁוּ נְחָלָיִךְ:
content.english: Like a well, draw [their] water, [until] your rivers are dry.

content.hebrew: Yona, le’edech re’i / ḳolech betsevaḥ se’i
content.transliteration: יוֹנָה, לְאֵידֵךְ רְאִי / קוֹלֵךְ בְּצֶוַח שְׂאִי
content.english: O dove, see, and raise your voice in cry,

content.hebrew: Ki va ve’artsech she’i / yaḡon beḡilayich.
content.transliteration: כִּי בָא בְאַרְצֵךְ שְׁאִי / יָגוֹן בְּגִילָיִךְ:
content.english: For destruction has befallen your land; and anguish, your joy.

content.hebrew: Nidda kesis raḥaḳi / to‘é keshikkor beḳi
content.transliteration: נִ֯דָּה כְּסִיס רַחֲקִי / תֹּעֶה כְּשִׁכּוֹר בְּקִי
content.english: Stay apart, withdraw like a crane, as you wander in vomit like a drunkard,

content.hebrew: Vaḥni ye‘enim beḳi- / na hi meḥolayich.
content.transliteration: וַחְנִי יְעֵנִים בְּקִי־ / נָה הִי מְחוֹלָיִךְ:
content.english: And camp with ostriches in lament and sighs, [instead of] your dances.

content.hebrew: Yona, le’edech re’i / ḳolech betsevaḥ se’i
content.transliteration: יוֹנָה, לְאֵידֵךְ רְאִי / קוֹלֵךְ בְּצֶוַח שְׂאִי
content.english: O dove, see, and raise your voice in cry,

content.hebrew: Ki va ve’artsech she’i / yaḡon beḡilayich.
content.transliteration: כִּי בָא בְאַרְצֵךְ שְׁאִי / יָגוֹן בְּגִילָיִךְ:
content.english: For destruction has befallen your land; and anguish, your joy.

content.hebrew: Midbar keshikkor te‘i / efer bemishkav tse‘i
content.transliteration: מִ֯דְבָּר כְּשִׁכּוֹר תְּעִי / אֵפֶר בְּמִשְׁכָּב צְעִי
content.english: Wander in the wilderness, like a drunkard, crouch in the dust as your bed,

content.hebrew: Mara bevicha ve‘i / rabbu ḥalalayich.
content.transliteration: מָרָה בְּבִכְיָה בְעִי / רַבּוּ חֲלָלָיִךְ:
content.english: Call out in cries, bitterly. Many are your people that have been killed!

content.hebrew: Yona, le’edech re’i / ḳolech betsevaḥ se’i
content.transliteration: יוֹנָה, לְאֵידֵךְ רְאִי / קוֹלֵךְ בְּצֶוַח שְׂאִי
content.english: O dove, see, and raise your voice in cry,

content.hebrew: Ki va ve’artsech she’i / yaḡon beḡilayich.
content.transliteration: כִּי בָא בְאַרְצֵךְ שְׁאִי / יָגוֹן בְּגִילָיִךְ:
content.english: For destruction has befallen your land; and anguish, your joy.

content.hebrew: Shommi ‘adina bezé / mashal lenadiv bezé
content.transliteration: שֹׁ֯מִּי עֲדִינָה בְּזֶה / מָשָׁל לְנָדִיב בְּזֶה
content.english: Be appalled about this, O you who are given to luxury; you are compared to a noble. On this

content.hebrew: Ḥodesh leshana hazé / hirbu ḥalalayich.
content.transliteration: חֹדֶשׁ לְשָׁנָה, הֲזֶה / הִרְבּוּ חֲלָלָיִךְ:
content.english: Month of the year, they killed so many of your people.

content.hebrew: Yona, le’edech re’i / ḳolech betsevaḥ se’i
content.transliteration: יוֹנָה, לְאֵידֵךְ רְאִי / קוֹלֵךְ בְּצֶוַח שְׂאִי
content.english: O dove, see, and raise your voice in cry,

content.hebrew: Ki va ve’artsech she’i / yaḡon beḡilayich.
content.transliteration: כִּי בָא בְאַרְצֵךְ שְׁאִי / יָגוֹן בְּגִילָיִךְ:
content.english: For destruction has befallen your land; and anguish, your joy.

content.hebrew: Hakki leḥayech ‘alé / damim devirech melé
content.transliteration: הַ֯כִּי לְחָיֵךְ, עֲלֵי / דָמִים, דְּבִירֵךְ מְלֵא
content.english: Slap your cheeks, about the blood [that has been shed], with your Temple full [of tears or blood];

content.hebrew: Lotan betocho shelé / shibber ne‘ulayich.
content.transliteration: לוֹטָן בְּתוֹכוֹ שְׁלֵה / שִׁבֵּר נְעוּלָיִךְ:
content.english: Lotan, sitting at ease inside it, had broken your locks [and gained entrance].

content.hebrew: Yona, le’edech re’i / ḳolech betsevaḥ se’i
content.transliteration: יוֹנָה, לְאֵידֵךְ רְאִי / קוֹלֵךְ בְּצֶוַח שְׂאִי
content.english: O dove, see, and raise your voice in cry,

content.hebrew: Ki va ve’artsech she’i / yaḡon beḡilayich.
content.transliteration: כִּי בָא בְאַרְצֵךְ שְׁאִי / יָגוֹן בְּגִילָיִךְ:
content.english: For destruction has befallen your land; and anguish, your joy.

content.hebrew: Ḥizḳi yeḡonech beḳir / ye‘or ‘atsavech keḳir
content.transliteration: חִ֯זְקִי יְגוֹנֵךְ בְּקִיר / יֵעוֹר עֲצָבֵךְ, כְּקִיר
content.english: Be mighty with your anguish, may your sadness be poured out at the wall, like Kir

content.hebrew: ‘Era lemaḡen veḳir / ra‘at gedolayich.
content.transliteration: עֵרָה לְמָגֵן, וְקִיר / רָעַת גְּדוֹלָיִךְ:
content.english: Uncovering the shield, and the outpour of the wickedness of your great ones.

content.hebrew: Yona, le’edech re’i / ḳolech betsevaḥ se’i
content.transliteration: יוֹנָה, לְאֵידֵךְ רְאִי / קוֹלֵךְ בְּצֶוַח שְׂאִי
content.english: O dove, see, and raise your voice in cry,

content.hebrew: Ki va ve’artsech she’i / yaḡon beḡilayich.
content.transliteration: כִּי בָא בְאַרְצֵךְ שְׁאִי / יָגוֹן בְּגִילָיִךְ:
content.english: For destruction has befallen your land; and anguish, your joy.

content.hebrew: Zakku nezirech kemo / sheleḡ levanon shemo
content.transliteration: זַ֯כּוּ נְזִירֵךְ כְּמוֹ / שֶׁלֶג לְבָנוֹן שְׁמוֹ
content.english: Your nazirites were pure like the snow called Lebanon.

content.hebrew: Ḥashach me’oram kemo / tofesé ḥalilayich.
content.transliteration: חָשַׁךְ מְאוֹרָם, כְּמוֹ / תֹּפְשֵׂי חֲלִילָיִךְ:
content.english: Their brightness has now become dark, like those that hold your flutes.

content.hebrew: Yona, le’edech re’i / ḳolech betsevaḥ se’i
content.transliteration: יוֹנָה, לְאֵידֵךְ רְאִי / קוֹלֵךְ בְּצֶוַח שְׂאִי
content.english: O dove, see, and raise your voice in cry,

content.hebrew: Ki va ve’artsech she’i / yaḡon beḡilayich.
content.transliteration: כִּי בָא בְאַרְצֵךְ שְׁאִי / יָגוֹן בְּגִילָיִךְ:
content.english: For destruction has befallen your land; and anguish, your joy.

content.hebrew: Ḳir’i letsurech ḥamol / ḥesed emet li ḡemol
content.transliteration: קִ֯רְאִי לְצוּרֵךְ, חֲמוֹל / חֶסֶד אֱמֶת לִי גְמוֹל
content.english: Call out to your Rock, to have mercy: “Treat me with true kindness.

content.hebrew: Basser amatecha temol / livshi me‘ilayich.
content.transliteration: בַּשֵּׂר אֲמָתְךָ תְּמוֹל / לִבְשִׁי מְעִילָיִךְ:
content.english: Announce, to your maidservant, already: Wear your raiments!”

content.hebrew: Yona, le’edech re’i / ḳolech betsevaḥ se’i
content.transliteration: יוֹנָה, לְאֵידֵךְ רְאִי / קוֹלֵךְ בְּצֶוַח שְׂאִי
content.english: O dove, see, and raise your voice in cry,

content.hebrew: Ki va ve’artsech she’i / yaḡon beḡilayich.
content.transliteration: כִּי בָא בְאַרְצֵךְ שְׁאִי / יָגוֹן בְּגִילָיִךְ:
content.english: For destruction has befallen your land; and anguish, your joy.

content.hebrew: Kakkatuv: ‘Uri ‘uri livshi ‘uzzech tsiyyon, livshi biḡdé tifartech.
content.transliteration: כַּכָּתוּב: עוּרִ֥י עוּרִ֛י לִבְשִׁ֥י עֻזֵּ֖ךְ צִיּ֑וֹן לִבְשִׁי בִּגְדֵי תִפְאַרְתֵּךְ:
content.english: As it is written: Awake, awake, Put on thy strength, O Zion; Put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city.
